welcome.title: Welcome to vngoweb!
welcome.subtitle: Want a quick walkthrough on building your own professional website? It only takes about 2 minutes.
features: Customize content & images — with AI help
Publish instantly with your own shareable link
welcome.footnote: You can reopen this guide anytime from the compass icon in the menu bar.

tour.routeHint: Click the highlighted element to continue

dashboard-sidebar.title: Your management menu
dashboard-sidebar.body: This is the main navigation: Projects, Analytics, QR Codes, Settings and Support — everything you need lives here.

dashboard-create-cta.title: Build your first website
dashboard-create-cta.body: Click here to browse a library of 100+ beautiful templates, optimized for every kind of business.

marketplace-categories.title: Filter by business type
marketplace-categories.body: Pick the right category — cafe, restaurant, spa, gym, wedding, homestay, dental clinic... to see the templates that fit you best.

marketplace-pick-template.title: Choose a template you like
marketplace-pick-template.body: Hover over a template's image and click "Use free" (or "Buy now") to start customizing — no card required to try it out.

editor-panel.title: Customize your content
editor-panel.body: Fill in your shop name, description, photos, menu, contact info... on the left. Every change appears instantly in the preview on the right.

editor-ai-tools.title: Let AI handle the heavy lifting
editor-ai-tools.body: Auto-fill your entire website from a Google Maps link, or translate the whole site into English / Chinese / Korean in one click.

ai-assistant-widget.title: Your AI assistant is on standby
ai-assistant-widget.body: Need a quick edit? Just type what you want in plain language (e.g. "change the headline to...") — drag this button anywhere on screen.

editor-publish.title: Publish your website
editor-publish.body: When you're happy with it, hit "Publish" to put your website online — you'll instantly get your own link to share with customers.
